fields.name: Players
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x5A9500 ecl::multiplayer::DropInApprovalSystem::ProcessDecisions builds a local ls::DynamicArray of shorts (element stride 2: *(short*)(data + i*2)) from approved host-side join requests whose user id's peer equals the local peer ((short)UserId), then gets this singleton (its 'No singleton found' path names GetTypeName<ecl::multiplayer::DestroyPlayerRequestsSingletonComponent>, FUN_1805A3AC0) and move-assigns the local array into it. macOS default: 16 zero bytes; live: empty.

second_pass: Confirmed on Windows: bg3.exe+0x1AD4430 (~ProcessDecisions) builds a local array of shorts (stride 2, the low 16 bits of an approved UserId) and move-assigns it into the singleton (buffer +0, capacity +8, size +0xC); creator bg3.exe+0x1AD73A0 allocates 0x10 bytes and zeroes them.
open_questions: Element is the low 16 bits of a UserId (local user/player number); whether SE should expose it as int16_t or uint16_t is not settled (code declares short).
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
